messages:
lucy-pm: Quick alignment thread: Sales flagged 3 customers asking for "strict isolation" + measurable latency SLAs. We need to decide scope, pricing, and cutover plan by next Wed.

jordan-arch: Need to separate product decision (what we promise) from infra approach (how). Options: logical isolation (namespaces/soft lanes) vs full dedicated fleet per tenant. Each has different risk/cost profiles.

rui-eng: From infra POV: logical lanes are feasible within 6w with policy-as-code, routing heuristics, and cache partitioning. Dedicated fleets need procurement and infra changes ~12w.

sam-ops: Ops considerations: with logical lanes we still get noisy neighbor effects on shared HW when tail traffic spikes. We need preemptive throttles and emergency eviction playbooks. Dedicated nodes give stronger isolation but doubling capacity is expensive.

belinda-product: Product asks: 1) A tier that guarentees p95 below X ms, 2) an opt-in "compliance lane" with data residency + isolation. Sales wants pricing delta and clear migration story.

omar-ml: Model-serving implications: some model variants (16-bit FP) are heavier on memory; isolation lanes may force us to prefer quantized variants which can impact quality. We should capture acceptable quality deltas per customer.

lucy-pm: Let's define launch gates we can agree on. Proposed minimal gating matrix: gate:criteria:action lines.

jordan-arch: Draft gating matrix (proposal):
```
Gate 1 - Observability: end-to-end tracing + per-tenant metrics live, alerts wired. Block rollout without.
Gate 2 - Performance: internal canary p95 <= 300ms for isolation lane under 95th percentile load.
Gate 3 - Correctness: no regression on customer-kept prompt set (>98% similarity).
Gate 4 - Failover: policy fallback completes < 3s when isolation capacity is exhausted.
Gate 5 - Billing: billing events for isolation usage tested and reconciled.
```

rui-eng: Add a cost gate: expected per-token cost uplift < 2x vs shared baseline or exec approval required.

belinda-product: Agree. Also add legal approval for SLA wording for latency and data residency. I can draft.

sam-ops: Rollout plan suggestion: A: internal dev org canary -> B: 1 pilot customer (paid, low-volume) -> C: 5 pilot customers (mixed) -> D: general availability. Rollback triggers: sustained error_rate > 2% or p95 increase > 40% for 10m.

lucy-pm: Ownership: Product (Belinda) owns customer comms & pricing; Arch (Jordan) owns policy design; Eng (Rui) owns infra deliverables; Ops (Sam) owns runbooks and automation; ML (Omar) owns quality gates.

jordan-arch: Implementation details: policy-as-code repo with staged policies per environment, automated integration tests that simulate region outage and capacity pressure. Example policy snippet: `policy: { lane: "isolation", fallback: "shared_safeguard", eviction_threshold: 0.85 }`.

omar-ml: For quality gate, we'll require customer-specific eval harness keyed by prompt slices. If quality drop > 5% for any critical slice we fail the gate. We'll need prompt ingestion consent.

belinda-product: Pricing model thoughts: add a flat premium + per-token uplift for isolation. Also offer migration credits for early pilots. Need ballpark numbers for finance.

rui-eng: Technical estimate (rough): soft isolation core work 6w (2 engs), integration tests + canary infra 2w (1 eng), billing and metrics 2w (1 eng). Hard isolation (dedicated fleet) adds 8-10w for infra provisioning and scheduling.

sam-ops: Ops tasks: autoscaling policies for isolation lanes, evacuation automation, incident runbooks, and billing alerting. I'll schedule a runbook review.

lucy-pm: Decision checkpoint: Do we GA soft isolation first and follow with hard isolation pilot? Pros: faster to market, covers 80% of customers. Cons: won't satisfy highest-regulated customers immediately. Thoughts?

jor dan-arch: Typo in mention. (oops)

jordan-arch: I vote soft-first + parallel hard-isolation pilot for 1-2 anchor regulated customers. That reduces time-to-value while capturing compliance deals.

belinda-product: Agreed. We'll qualify customers for hard isolation pilot and require contract language changes.

omar-ml: One more: ensure model variant compatibility matrix is published so Sales can set expectations.

ci-bot: CI: isolation-policy-tests passed on branch feature/isolation-routing (build 842) — all unit/integration tests green.

lucy-pm: Action items recap: Belinda -> SLA draft + pricing proposal by Tue. Jordan -> policy repo skeleton + tests by next planning. Rui -> infra spike estimate and dependency list. Sam -> runbook draft. Omar -> eval harness plan + consent checklist. I'll assemble PRD.

belinda-product: I'll loop in finance & legal today.

sam-ops: I'll add rollback automation to the ops backlog.

lucy-pm: Thanks. If no objections I'll lock the gating matrix and request formal estimates in the sprint planning meeting. :shipit:
